"This is not the story of a nation; this is the story of a band," music producer Juan De Marcos (Luis Vega) says at the top of Buena Vista Social Club.

cn.t: Critics praise this jukebox musical as an uplifting cultural triumph elevated by infectious Cuban rhythms and exquisite craftsmanship that transcends the genre's usual pitfalls, though audiences remain frustratingly seated when the music begs them to dance.
